default_contract.purpose: Define and organize only the subject named by source_title.
default_contract.intended_reader_outcome: Reader outcome must remain limited to source_title and later approved scope detail.
default_contract.inclusion_scope: Content directly necessary to address source_title.
default_contract.exclusion_scope: Sibling-owned subjects, unsupported claims, and unresolved outline material.
default_contract.relation_to_parent_chapter: Contributes its named subject within parent_id; does not replace chapter-wide synthesis.

boundary_rules.risk: general tunnel history versus KGM tunnel history
boundary_rules.boundary: CH-A-S03 is general history; CH-C is KGM-specific institutional history.

boundary_rules.risk: construction cost factors versus construction-cost chapter
boundary_rules.boundary: CH-B-S08 covers factors only; CH-F owns cost-study method, analysis, and chapter synthesis.
CH-E-S04 defines the activity domain; cost sections own monetary classification and analysis.
Each review is restricted to its parent chapter's cost domain; shared evidence must retain separate relevance mappings.
CH-F-S06 owns construction-cost analysis method/output; CH-G owns cross-chapter reported findings, conclusions, and recommendations without duplicating analysis.

boundary_rules.risk: combined heading overlaps following purpose/scope/method headings
boundary_rules.boundary: Source hierarchy is unresolved; do not duplicate content or infer parenthood until human approval.
Terminological distinction and content allocation require human confirmation.
